project.title: Walmart Sales Analysis
project.description: A Power BI business intelligence project analyzing Walmart weekly sales, holiday performance, seasonality, and external economic indicators to generate actionable business insights.
project.problem: The business lacked visibility into weekly sales performance, seasonal demand, and the impact of holidays and economic indicators, making it difficult to optimize planning, inventory, and marketing decisions.
project.solution: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard using a Star Schema data model, DAX measures, and time intelligence to analyze sales trends, holiday performance, store comparisons, and external economic factors.
project.businessValue: Enabled data-driven decision making by identifying seasonal sales patterns, measuring holiday impact, comparing store performance, and demonstrating that holidays had a significantly greater influence on revenue than short-term economic indicators.
